fullPassage: Honey can be eaten by itself or mixed with other ingredients. Natural or pure honey has had no additives, preservatives or synthetic ingredients added. Also referred to as 'undiluted', it is usually more expensive than diluted honeys. Natural honey can also be called 'blended honey', in which honeys from various sources are blended together — not by the bees, but by human processors and distributors in stages after the honey has been collected. Blending is frequently done for taste as well as marketing reasons, especially since some consumers find the darker honeys too strong. Mixing different types of honey together can make it more palatable, and also gives a more uniform flavour — this is an important consideration for producers and retailers, who feel the need to guarantee reliable, unsurprising (typically mild) flavours to their customers. Clover is one of the most popular honeys in the U.S., and its mild flavour and taste have become familiar to many Americans.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a substance added to food to preserve it or improve its appearance or taste"

det.korean: 음식을 보존하거나 외관/맛을 개선하기 위해 첨가되는 물질 = additive(첨가물)
det.analysis:
❌ ① ingredient: 재료 → 음식을 구성하는 일반 재료이지 보존/개선 목적의 첨가물이 아님
❌ ② flavour: 맛 → 물질이 아니라 감각적 특성
❌ ③ nutrient: 영양소 → 영양적 가치를 제공하는 물질이지 보존 목적이 아님
✅ ④ additive: 첨가물 → 음식에 보존/개선 목적으로 넣는 물질과 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: additive = 첨가물. 천연 꿀에는 additives, preservatives가 없다

questions.passage: Natural or pure honey has had no additives, __________ (preserve) or synthetic ingredients added.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: additives, preservatives or synthetic ingredients = 첨가물, 방부제 또는 합성 재료. preserve → 명사형 preservatives

det.tip: preserve(동사: 보존하다) → preservatives(명사: 방부제). additives, preservatives, synthetic ingredients 나열 구조

det.analysis: 명사 surprise → 형용사 unsurprising. 'reliable, _____ flavours'에서 명사를 수식하는 형용사가 필요하고, 문맥상 '놀랍지 않은(무난한)'이라는 부정 의미
